summary.reading: Wall 1 is a real defect: 65% of real issues are refused before any work, and the confidence signal rises as content falls. Wall 2 is the binding constraint: with no container the transport returns BLOCKED_NO_MODEL_PROPOSAL and emits no patch. Because wall 2 is closed, raising wall-1 acceptance from 28/80 to 80/80 changes no measured outcome -- so the honest next object is the generator, not the gate. The concentration numbers say where the generator would have to live: 415 of 447 capabilities never win a real issue and the median capability carries 7 index terms, so the routing table is 447 labels over a 32-way decision.
summary.what_this_does_not_show: any benchmark score, any solved task, any patch. Wall 2 is measured with NO container attached, which proves the transport fails closed without one; it does not prove the container-side solver fails when one IS attached. The published CI smoke run is the evidence for that, and it recorded BLOCKED_NO_MODEL_PROPOSAL with patch_bytes 0 for both tasks it ran.
